home.title: PrimePrometics - Pro-Age Make-up That Heals
home.fit: **Makeup, not skincare — but a clean adjacent fit.** Colour cosmetics for mature women, with the 'pro-age' framing doing the differentiating. Highly demo-able (application on mature skin, before/after on lashes) and the audience overlaps the mature-skin skincare brands in this list, so an avatar pool is shared. Treat as its own angle set. **Claim flag:** the brand's own tagline is 'Make-up That Heals' — 'heals' is drug-claim language and must not carry into creative, even though it is their line.
